meta.title: Compound Interest Calculator - Free Online Tool | Optimizo
meta.description: Calculate compound interest and watch your money grow. Enter principal, rate, and time to see future value with different compounding frequencies.
meta.subtitle: Calculate how your investments grow with compound interest

content.what_text: Compound interest is the interest calculated on both the initial principal and the accumulated interest from previous periods. It is often described as 'interest on interest' and is a powerful concept in finance and investing.
content.formula_text: A = P(1 + r/n)^(nt), where A = final amount, P = principal, r = annual rate, n = compounding frequency, t = time in years.
tips: The more frequently interest compounds, the more you earn
Start investing early to maximize the power of compounding
Regular contributions significantly boost long-term growth
Even small differences in interest rates matter over decades
